h1_old: How to Dismiss a Traffic Ticket in El Paso with Defensive Driving

faqs.q: How much does it cost to dismiss a ticket in El Paso?
faqs.a: The court cost is typically up to about $144 ($169 in a school zone), set by each court — some El Paso-area courts charge less. The TDLR-approved course is separate; ours is $28. Check your court's page for the exact amount.

faqs.q: Can I take the El Paso defensive driving course online?
faqs.a: Yes. Once the court approves your request, a TDLR-approved 6-hour course can be completed fully online. Every El Paso-area court accepts a state-approved online course.

faqs.q: My ticket is from Socorro / Horizon City / San Elizario, not El Paso. Does that change things?
faqs.a: The legal steps are the same, but you deal with that city's court — each with its own fee, request method, and deadlines. Open its page in the table above.

faqs.q: How long do I have to finish?
faqs.a: Generally 90 days after the court approves the request. Request the course by your appearance date first, and don't pay the ticket — paying is a guilty plea and a conviction.

faqs.q: Does a dismissal keep it off my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. A driving safety course dismissal keeps the charge off your driving record under Texas law, so it can't raise your insurance — unlike paying, which is a conviction.

courts.name: El Paso Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Anthony Municipal Court
courts.note: Anthony Municipal Court (El Paso County, TX — on the TX–NM line at I-10) hasn't posted its DSC fee — call (915) 886-3272 or email AMC@townofanthonytx.org by your appearance date to request dismissal.

courts.name: Clint Municipal Court
courts.note: Got a ticket in Clint (El Paso County, SE metro)? The Clint Municipal Court hasn't posted its DSC fee — call (915) 851-3146 by your appearance date to confirm the amount and request the driving safety course option. Complete a TDLR-approved course and submit your certificate to get the ticket dismissed.

courts.name: Horizon City Municipal Court
courts.note: Horizon City Municipal Court (El Paso County, I-10 east) handles traffic ticket dismissals via Driver Safety Course — the court hasn't posted its DSC fee online, so call (915) 852-1048 before your appearance date.

courts.name: San Elizario Municipal Court
courts.note: San Elizario Municipal Court (El Paso County) hasn't posted its DSC fee online — call (915) 302-2050 before your appearance date to confirm.

courts.name: Socorro Municipal Court
courts.note: Socorro accepts DSC requests by email — $144 court fee, and both completion documents must be submitted together.
